body: A scalable model serving library for building online inference APIs.
plain_description: **Scale Python and AI workloads from a laptop to a cluster.** Use Ray’s libraries for data, distributed training, hyperparameter tuning, reinforcement learning, and serving. Monitor applications and clusters with the Ray Dashboard.
technical_description: Ray is a framework for scaling Python and AI applications. It combines a distributed runtime with libraries for scalable datasets, distributed training, hyperparameter tuning, reinforcement learning, and programmable serving. Ray runs on machines, clusters, cloud providers, and Kubernetes; it can be installed with `pip install ray`.
title: Ray Serve
